title: Das Landhaus Apartments Prägant
description: Live availability, rates and offers: Das Landhaus Apartments Prägant, Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description:
Check live availability and exact prices at Landhaus Apartments Prägant for concrete dates and a party.

Use this whenever a guest names dates — it is the main tool. It applies the booking rules (arrival days,
minimum stay, closures), recommends the apartment that suits the party best (with reasons, e.g. 2 separate
bedrooms for families) and lists the free apartments with their total price (incl. final cleaning and
tourist tax); the total of the recommended apartment (or of `apartment`) is split into stay, final
cleaning and tourist tax — for another apartment call again with its number. Plus the payment and
cancellation terms, the website offers valid for the stay and a
pre-filled booking link per apartment. If the wish is not bookable it returns the nearest bookable
alternative dates with prices instead; parties larger than one apartment get a combination of apartments.
Ask for dates, number of adults and the ages of all children first — never assume them.
Not for: prices of a whole month without dates (get_rates), apartment descriptions (get_apartment_details).
To show the result visually, call render_availability_card with the same arguments.

Behaviour: read-only, nothing is booked or reserved, no personal data. Live from the property's booking
system (typically 1-2 s, identical requests cached up to 15 min). Invalid input returns isError with the reason.
Returns a text summary plus structuredContent (status, apartments with breakdown and booking_url,
alternatives, group, terms, offers, inquiry_url).

tools.name: render_availability_card
tools.description:
Show the availability result for given dates and party as an interactive card in the chat.

Use after check_availability (or instead of it) when the guest wants to SEE the options: photos, total
price with an expandable breakdown, a booking button per apartment, tappable alternative dates. Use
check_availability alone when only reasoning over the data or when the client cannot display cards.
Behaviour and arguments are identical to check_availability (read-only, live, nothing booked); the result
additionally contains small photos and the Google rating. Returns the same text and structuredContent.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description:
Get the price level of each apartment for a whole month plus that month's booking rules.

Use when the guest has no exact dates yet ("what does a week in July cost?", "when is it cheapest?").
For each apartment it returns the lowest total price of a real reference stay in that month (usually 7
nights, incl. final cleaning and tourist tax) and the arrival days / minimum stay / closures of the month.
Not for exact prices on specific dates — use check_availability for that. Visual version:
render_rates_card with the same arguments.
Behaviour: read-only, live from the booking system (about 1-2 s, cached 5 min). Returns text plus
structuredContent (apartments, periods, weeks, perks, offers).

children.description: Ages of ALL children 0-17, comma-separated, e.g. '8,15'; empty if none. Ages change price and tourist tax (charged from age 17).

tools.name: get_apartment_details
tools.description:
Describe one or all apartments: size, bedrooms, maximum guests, description and page link.

Use for questions about the apartments themselves ("how big is #16?", "which apartment has 2 bedrooms?",
"which apartments fit 5 people?"). It contains no prices or availability — use check_availability for
dates and prices, or get_rates for a month overview. Studio #17 is only listed when asked for by number and
is marked as bookable on request. Visual version with photos: render_apartment_gallery.
Behaviour: read-only; facts as maintained on praegant.net (synced hourly), answers in milliseconds.
Returns text plus structuredContent.apartments (nr, name, m2, bedrooms, max_guests, description, url,
on_request, images, and where maintained: beds, outdoor, notes, recommended_for). An unknown number
returns the list of existing apartment numbers.

name.description: Apartment number such as '12' or '#16'; empty or 'all' = all online-bookable apartments; '17' = Studio #17 (on request only)
name.title: Name

tools.name: render_apartment_gallery
tools.description:
Show one or all apartments with photos as an interactive gallery card in the chat.

Use instead of get_apartment_details when the guest wants to see the apartments (one apartment: up to 3
swipeable photos; all: one photo each, with buttons to check availability or open the page). Same
arguments, behaviour (read-only, no prices) and result as get_apartment_details, plus photos.
The card already shows the official photos — do not add images from a web search (other rentals share the
'Prägant' name).

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description:
List all current seasonal offers and packages published on praegant.net.

Use when the guest asks about deals, packages or what is special in a season, independent of dates.
When the guest already has dates, check_availability includes only the offers valid for that stay — no
need to call both. Visual version: render_offers_card.
Behaviour: read-only; offers as published on the website (synced hourly, expired ones removed).
Returns text plus structuredContent.offers (title, valid_from, valid_to, price_text, summary, url).

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description:
Build a direct booking link on praegant.net, optionally pre-filled with dates, party and apartment.

Use when the guest has decided and just wants the link, or wants to book without a price check. Bookings
are always completed by the guest on praegant.net — this connector never books, reserves
or takes payment by design. check_availability already returns a booking link per free apartment, so
call this only when no availability result is at hand. Dates are optional (YYYY-MM-DD); without them the
link opens the booking page.
Behaviour: read-only, no availability check, instant. Returns text plus structuredContent (booking_url,
inquiry_url, phone, email).

tools.name: get_region_info
tools.description:
Return curated information about Bad Kleinkirchheim and the house for a topic.

Use for "what can we do there?" and house questions: house rules and services (self-catering, no
breakfast, bread-roll service, no pets, baby cot/high chair on request, chip access), skiing (winter),
hiking, biking and lakes (summer), thermal spas and the in-house sauna (wellness), golf incl. the free
green fee and tee-time booking, families, workation, arrival. The Kärnten Card (summer only) and the free green fee are explained exactly. Not for
prices or availability (check_availability) and not for apartment facts (get_apartment_details).
Behaviour: read-only, static curated content from the property (no web search), instant; topics
'house' and 'wellness' also list the property's official house photos (sauna, steam bath, relaxation
room …) — to show them, call render_house_photos, never a web image search (other businesses share the
'Prägant' name). Returns text plus structuredContent.topics (topic, lines), photos (kind, url, caption)
and contact details.

topic.description: One of house (self-catering, bread rolls, pets, baby cot, chip access), winter, summer, wellness, golf, family, workation, arrival (aliases like 'ski', 'hund', 'breakfast', 'anreise' work); empty = overview
topic.title: Topic

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

Show the property's official photos of the house as an interactive card in the chat.

and result as get_region_info for the topic, plus the photos in the card.
